channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Britain to take command of major NATO naval force
item.description: The Royal Navy has begun the process of taking command of NATO’s Maritime Allied Reaction Force, the alliance’s primary naval crisis response formation. The post Britain to take command of major NATO naval force first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Neutrality offers no shield as hybrid threats reach Ireland
item.description: CEPA, a leading European security think tank, told the UK Defence Journal that Irish neutrality has no impact on Russian actions against the country or Europe as a whole. The post Neutrality offers no shield as hybrid threats reach Ireland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to decide fate of Ajax as safety probe begins
item.description: A formal safety investigation into the Army’s Ajax armoured vehicle will take at least two weeks, the Ministry of Defence has confirmed, in a move that deepens uncertainty around the programme. The post UK to decide fate of Ajax as safety probe begins first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Building ‘up to 12’ new subs requires major Barrow expansion
item.description: Sir Stephen Lovegrove has told MPs that the UK’s ability to deliver AUKUS submarines depends on sustained political commitment, long term investment in Barrow, and a more disciplined approach to major nuclear projects across Government. The post Building ‘up to 12’ new subs requires major Barrow expansion first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: America fields ‘attack drone’ squadron in Middle East
item.description: U.S. Central Command has created a new task force to stand up the U.S. military’s first one-way attack drone squadron in the Middle East. The post America fields ‘attack drone’ squadron in Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Typhoon jets to fly to Arctic for secret escort mission
item.description: The UK Defence Journal understands that Typhoon jets will be deploying to the Arctic later this month for what is intended to be a secret escort mission involving a cargo aircraft. The post Typhoon jets to fly to Arctic for secret escort mission first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US strike kills four in latest lethal action in Carribean
item.description: American assets carried out a lethal strike on a vessel in international waters on 4 December under orders from U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. The post US strike kills four in latest lethal action in Carribean first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Police urge winter vigilance as terror threat substantial
item.description: Counter Terrorism Policing North East and Durham Constabulary have issued a winter safety appeal as crowds gather across the region for Christmas markets, shopping and seasonal events. The post Police urge winter vigilance as terror threat substantial first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK launches Atlantic Bastion to counter Russia at sea
item.description: The project links autonomous vessels, AI enabled detection networks and existing naval and air platforms, the government stated. The post UK launches Atlantic Bastion to counter Russia at sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Drivers jailed after nearly 50 migrants found in lorries
item.description: Two Romanian drivers have been jailed for attempting to smuggle almost fifty people from the UK into France using vans and lorries, following a National Crime Agency operation at Dover Port in September. The post Drivers jailed after nearly 50 migrants found in lorries first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
